title: Git 2.56.1 fixes six vulnerabilities. One, CVE-2026-111760, lets a malicious repository run attacker code when someone clones it recursively
content_md:
Git 2.56.1 fixes six vulnerabilities. One, CVE-2026-111760, lets a malicious repository run attacker code when someone clones it recursively
